copy.heading: Understanding ceramic coating cost in Norwich
paragraphs: Ceramic coating cost depends on three things: the size of your vehicle, how long you want the protection to last, and whether the paint needs correcting first. Prices start from £445 for a small car on the 3 + 1 Year package and rise to £895 for an extra large vehicle with paint correction and a 7-year coating.

Every package includes the wash, decontamination and panel preparation the coating needs, so the price covers the full job rather than just the product. The 3 + 1 Year package gives 4 years of protection and suits daily drivers and family cars in good condition. The 7-year package suits new cars and well-kept paint, and is booked as one appointment of about 10 working hours.

If your paint has swirls, haze or light scratches, the Paint Correction + 7-Year Ceramic package is the better choice. We correct the finish first, then coat it, so you are not sealing in defects. Alloy wheel coating and soft top treatments can be added to a suitable main service booking.

To work out your ceramic coating cost, choose the size that matches your vehicle: small, medium, large or extra large. You select it when you book, and we confirm it before your appointment. You can book and pay securely online, or call us on 01603 517142 if you would like to talk it through first.
